messages:
elena: Heads up — found an access regression in Console RBAC. Users with 'editor' role can't open KMS key detail page; they get a 403 in the UI.
Repro steps: 1) login as user with org role 'editor' 2) Settings → Security → KMS keys 3) click key → error.
Console log: `GET /api/v1/kms/keys/123 -> 403 {"code":"permission.denied","message":"missing: kms_view"}`
Screenshot: (redacted). @shawn any recent role-mapping changes? last deploy 03/18.

shawn: Saw it. We shipped the role refactor last week that split `console_admin` into `console_admin` + `kms_admin`. Looks like `kms_view` got dropped from the editor mapping during the refactor.
I can push a quick fallback to restore `kms_view` for editor while we decide the final mapping.

mike: Is this an intentional restriction or an accidental removal? We need an audit trail before we change anything. @audit-bot can you surface who edited the role mappings and the change id? Also confirm no keys were accessed by editor users. If it's accidental, mark for vuln triage.

audit-bot: role_mappings.yml updated by deploy-bot@ci at 1805020000.
Diff summary: removed `kms_view` from `editor`; added new role `kms_admin`. Change request: CSD-231. Logged event: EVT-1805.

kiera: Support reports — two tenants hit this after the deploy and opened tickets. They expect editors to at least see keys read-only. Hotfix to restore read access for editor seems reasonable until we roll out strict segregation.

shawn: Plan: revert the editor->kms_view removal in the RBAC engine as a 10-minute hotfix. Then ship a canary policy for strict mapping behind an org flag `kms_strict`. Canary criteria: only orgs marked with flag will get strict mapping, others remain legacy.
Patch snippet I'll apply:
```
# rbac_config.patch
- editor: ["project_edit","view_costs"]
+ editor: ["project_edit","view_costs","kms_view"]
```

elena: Adding an audit hook for failed `kms` read attempts so we can enumerate affected users and tenants quickly. Also attaching the small stack trace from the UI: `rbac: deny check failed at allow_if role_check -> missing kms_view`. Patch incoming.

mike: Good. Also add an incident entry and notify compliance. Confirmed from KMS audit logs: no Decrypt/Encrypt calls from editor identities in the last 24h, so material access wasn't granted. Marking severity as P2 pending confirmation from customers.

shawn: Rolling the hotfix now. Will post rollout status in 5m. :thumbsup:

kiera: I'll notify the two affected customers in #support and send an FYI email. Thanks all.
